name: Solution Adoption Planning
short_description: Structured planning session to define adoption milestones and success criteria for the SAP solution rollout.

name: Project Charter Review
short_description: Review and validate the project charter to ensure alignment with business objectives and SAP best practices.

name: Stakeholder Alignment Workshop
short_description: Facilitated workshop to align key stakeholders on project scope, timeline, and responsibilities across business and IT teams.

name: System Landscape Design
short_description: Design the target SAP system landscape including integration points, security zones, and infrastructure requirements.

name: Integration Architecture Review
short_description: Review existing integration patterns and define target architecture for connecting SAP with third-party systems.

name: Data Migration Strategy
short_description: Define data migration approach including cleansing rules, volume estimates, and cutover strategy for legacy data transition.

name: Security & Authorization Concept
short_description: Develop comprehensive security concept covering role design, authorization objects, and compliance requirements.

name: Hypercare Support
short_description: Dedicated go-live support with on-site SAP experts to ensure system stability and rapid issue resolution during hypercare phase.

name: Performance Optimization Review
short_description: Systematic review of system performance metrics post go-live with recommendations for optimization and tuning.

name: User Adoption Measurement
short_description: Track and measure user adoption KPIs using SAP Analytics to identify areas for additional training and enablement.

name: System Health Check
short_description: Comprehensive technical health check covering configuration, performance, security patches, and upgrade readiness.
